paper.title: Risk-sensitive Bandits: Arm Mixture Optimality and Regret-efficient Algorithms

unmapped: Objective is a distortion riskmetric U_h of the mixture of arm CDFs weighted by empirical sampling fractions; regret = V(alpha*,F) - E[V(tau_T/T, F)], compared to the optimal (possibly mixture) allocation, not a cumulative sum of per-round regrets
Rewards are non-negative (Omega subset of R_+), 1-sub-Gaussian
DR bounded by B; U_h Hölder continuous (exponent q, constant L) and mixture-Hölder continuous (exponent r)
Algorithm requires the discrete minimum suboptimality gap Delta_min(eps) over the discretized simplex, and the Hölder parameters q, L
settings.definition_quote: we define the regret as the gap between the DR achieved by the oracle policy and the \emph{average} DR achieved by $\pi$, i.e., \mathfrak{R}_{\bnu}^\pi(T)\triangleq V(\balpha^\star, \F) - \E_{\bnu}^\pi[V(\frac{1}{T}\btau_T^\pi, \F )]. ... assume that the distributions $\F_i$ are $1-$sub-Gaussian

symbols.L_H: unified Hölder constant L = max{L_H, L_MH}
symbols.W: max ratio of Wasserstein to L1 distance between arm mixtures (<= sqrt(2 pi))
symbols.M_eps: N(eps)/log T, exploration length divided by log T (O(1), depends on Delta_min(eps))

conditions: U_h Hölder continuous with exponent q
tuning: exploration length N(eps) as in eq. (number of samples)

source.label: theorem: ETC upper bound
source.quote: For any $\varepsilon\in\R_+$ and distortion function $h$ with H\"older exponent $q$, for all $T>N(\varepsilon)$, RS-ETC-M's regret is upper bounded as \mathfrak{R}_{\bnu}^{{{\rm E}}}(T) \leq (\mcL K + W^{-q}) \bigg(3 WM(\varepsilon)\; \frac{\log T}{T} \bigg)^q + \Delta(\varepsilon).

results.notes: Regret is the DR gap of the average sampling mixture (not cumulative), so not multiplied by T; quantity set to other.

symbols.beta_gap: beta = lim_{eps->0} log Delta_min(eps)/log eps (gap scaling constant)

tuning: eps = Theta((K^{2+2/q} T^{-gamma} log T)^{q/(2 beta)}), gamma = 2beta/(2beta+r)

source.label: theorem:RS-ETC-M
source.quote: Under the conditions of Theorem \ref{theorem: ETC upper bound}, when $\beta$ exists, the minimum feasible regret RS-ETC-M satisfies is \mathfrak{R}_{\bnu}^{{\textnormal{\rm E}}}(T) \leq O\Bigg(\Bigg[K^{c_{\rm E}}\cdot \frac{\log T}{T^{\gamma}}\Bigg]^{\frac{qr}{2\beta}}\Bigg), where $c_{\rm E}\triangleq {2(1+\frac{\beta+1}{q})}$ and $\gamma = \frac{2\beta}{2\beta+r}$.

results.notes: Table 1 specializes to Bernoulli DRs (e.g. O(log T/T) for mean, CVaR, etc.).

symbols.B_U: upper bound B on the DR

conditions: U_h Hölder continuous with exponent q
T > max{e^K, T(eps)} with T(eps) instance-dependent

source.label: theorem:UCB upper bound
source.quote: For any $\varepsilon\in\R_+$, and distortion function $h$ with \holder exponent $q$, for all $T>\max\{\e^K,T(\varepsilon)\}$, for $\pi\in\{{\rm U,C}\}$ we have \mathfrak{R}_{\bnu}^{\pi }(T) \leq [B + \mcL(W^q+1)] \Bigg[\frac{64}{\sqrt{\varepsilon \rho T}}\Big( \sqrt{2\e\log T} + 32\Big)\Bigg]^q + \Delta(\varepsilon).

results.notes: Same statement covers CE-UCB-M (r4). Regret is DR gap of average mixture.
